brisamar-pescados.title: Brisamar Pescados • Catalog & E-commerce
brisamar-pescados.shortDescription: High-performance Web application in Next.js and Tailwind CSS for Box 130 at CEASA Foz do Iguaçu, featuring dynamic catalog and recipes.
brisamar-pescados.period: Commercial Production • CEASA Foz do Iguaçu
brisamar-pescados.description: Brisamar Pescados is a traditional company with over 30 years of excellence in fresh seafood at Box 130 in CEASA Foz do Iguaçu. I engineered a modern, ultra-fast, and responsive web platform serving wholesale clients (restaurants and markets) and retail shoppers alike.
brisamar-pescados.challenges: Built using Next.js with App Router and Server Components for instant load speeds and top Google indexability. Features categorized product filtering, a dedicated culinary recipes section with step-by-step instructions, direct WhatsApp ordering integration, and a modern oceanic aesthetic.

fleet-manager.title: Fleet Control System & Python Data Analysis
fleet-manager.shortDescription: Dockerized enterprise system for public logistics management in the Municipality of Umuarama, integrated with a Python robot for spreadsheet data mining and analytics.
fleet-manager.description: Robust internal system developed to manage municipal fleet dispatch, drivers, public yards, and fuel expenditure at the Municipality of Umuarama. The application evolved with the integration of an automated Python data analysis pipeline to process raw log spreadsheets.
fleet-manager.challengesTitle: Hybrid Laravel + Python Integration & Data Processing
fleet-manager.challenges: Developed a Python robot (using Pandas and OpenPyXL) to parse, sanitize, and statistically analyze raw fuel and odometer logs, detecting consumption anomalies and generating executive analytical reports for public expenditure savings. Backend structured in Laravel with Docker/Sail for absolute reliability.

jf-informatica.title: JF Informática e Games • Tech Support & Repair
jf-informatica.shortDescription: Modern and responsive commercial SPA with dynamic Dark/Light Mode and customer acquisition funnel for PC, laptop, and gaming console repairs.
jf-informatica.description: Digital platform created for a regional tech repair business specialized in computers, notebooks, printers, and gaming consoles. The goal was to establish an impactful, agile online presence with high conversion rates for local clients.
jf-informatica.challenges: Built an ultra-fast Single Page Application (SPA) architecture with Tailwind CSS, smooth micro-interactions, persistent browser dark/light mode toggle, and an interactive quote request form routing leads directly to WhatsApp support.

bem-digital.title: NGO Hub (Bem-Digital)
bem-digital.shortDescription: Full-featured modular system in Laravel and MySQL for managing donation campaigns, inventory, and donors.
bem-digital.description: Bem-Digital is a comprehensive modular system developed with Laravel (Blade/Alpine.js/Tailwind) and MySQL for managing donation campaigns, inventory control, and donor relations. It enables non-profit organizations to manage donations in real time with transparency and security.
bem-digital.challenges: The project required architecting a complex relational database using polymorphism and pivot tables for a modular Roles & Permissions system. Agile teamwork using Git, Clean Architecture, and Conventional Commits.

bolao-copa.title: World Cup Pool • React Native & Spring Boot
bolao-copa.shortDescription: Mobile app and API built during an academic Hackathon for sports betting and score predictions with React Native and Java Spring Boot.
bolao-copa.description: Mobile client-server solution created in a hackathon coding marathon for sports score predictions during the World Cup. Connects a reactive mobile app to a robust Java backend.
bolao-copa.challengesTitle: Mobile React Native & Spring Boot Integration
bolao-copa.challenges: High-velocity development under tight deadlines: engineering RESTful endpoints in Java with Spring Boot for scoring algorithms, consumed by a React Native interface.

hotsite-unialfa.title: UniALFA Hotsite • Hybrid Multi-Stack
hotsite-unialfa.shortDescription: Academic event portal integrating PHP front-end with Node.js and Java microservices and APIs, currently undergoing continuous refactoring.
hotsite-unialfa.description: Platform designed to manage event portals, registrations, and ticketing workflows at UniALFA. Combines multiple technology layers connecting a traditional PHP front-end to asynchronous backend services.
hotsite-unialfa.challenges: Orchestrating communication between Node.js REST endpoints and auxiliary Java modules consumed by the PHP client. Under active enhancement for future public rollout.

investment-manager.title: Investment Management System
investment-manager.shortDescription: Object-Oriented PHP application with MVC architecture and interactive return charts.
investment-manager.description: Application built in Object-Oriented PHP strictly following the MVC (Model-View-Controller) architecture. Enables users to register investments, track performance, and project earnings with dynamic charts.
investment-manager.challenges: Strict separation of concerns across business rules, data persistence, and UI presentation, applying Clean Code, class abstraction, and accurate financial calculations.

chopits.title: Chopits | E-commerce
chopits.shortDescription: Functional virtual store clone focused on global state management and dynamic routing.
chopits.description: Robust front-end application built to simulate the purchasing experience of a major e-commerce store, with interactive shopping cart, filtered product listings, and real-time total calculations.
chopits.challenges: Primary focus on strict TypeScript typing throughout the data flow, eliminating runtime errors and creating an ultra-fast UI with React components.

e-script-website.title: E-Script Website | Web Solutions
e-script-website.shortDescription: Modern web platform developed to showcase scripts, automation routines, and digital web utilities.
e-script-website.description: Structured website designed to showcase a catalog of scripts, automation tools, and web utilities aimed at developer productivity.
e-script-website.challenges: Implemented with a focus on web semantic standards, ultra-lightweight asset loading, and fluid responsiveness across all screen dimensions.

alfaplus.title: AlfaPlus | UniALFA Academic Portal
alfaplus.shortDescription: Academic portal and system developed during the Internet Systems degree program at UniALFA.
alfaplus.description: Application built to manage student workflows, courses, and grading within the academic ecosystem at UniALFA.
alfaplus.challenges: Built authentication flows, user permission tiers, and database queries for streamlined classroom management.

site-vitrine.title: Showcase Landing Page
site-vitrine.shortDescription: Clean, static, and responsive landing page built with pure HTML5 and modern CSS3.
site-vitrine.description: Institutional showcase landing page featuring a responsive layout, clean typography, and visual hierarchy crafted for product and service displays.
site-vitrine.challenges: Built without external CSS framework dependencies, leveraging CSS Grid, Flexbox, and native CSS animations to score 100 on Google Lighthouse.

We do not use third-party tracking cookies, advertising pixels, or invasive behavioral monitoring tools.
